evals.name: cfo-cloud-bill-deck
evals.prompt: My CFO wants a short deck tomorrow morning about why our AWS bill went from $31,200 in Q2 to $38,900 in Q3. Breakdown for Q3: compute 18,400 (Q2 was 17,100), storage 6,300 (was 5,500), data transfer 9,800 (was 4,200), support 4,400 (same both quarters). Our plan for Q3 was 33,000. Make it 6 to 8 slides in that hand-drawn sketchbook style and give me a PDF too.
evals.expected_output: A sketchy deck (one self-contained HTML file) of 6 to 8 slides that leads with the point, files the bill as a slip, shows plan versus record and the benchmark, uses only the given figures, plus a PDF with one page per slide.

assertions.text: A self-contained HTML deck exists (main.sk-deck present, no external script or stylesheet requests)
The deck has between 6 and 8 slides (.sk-slide)
skills/sketchy/scripts/lint.mjs reports 0 errors on the final HTML
The figures 38,900, 31,200, 33,000 and 9,800 appear exactly as given, and no dollar figure appears that is not given or derivable from the given numbers
Any itemised bill or slip sums to 38,900
The plan of 33,000 or Q2 of 31,200 is shown next to the Q3 total as a benchmark
Numbers are set in the record typeface (.sk-figure, data-count or Courier Prime), not only in handwriting
A PDF exists with the same page count as the number of slides

evals.name: vaccine-lesson-weak-readers
evals.prompt: I teach 9th grade biology. Make me a one-page hand-drawn explainer on how vaccines train the immune system, for students who struggle with reading. Keep it visual, and put one quick question at the end so I can check they got it.
evals.expected_output: A sketchy explainer page: picture first, numbered steps, short sentences, at least three sketches of real objects, a misconception or check question, readable at phone width, no invented statistics.

assertions.text: A self-contained HTML page exists using the sketchy engine (html.sk and body.sk)
lint.mjs reports 0 errors on the final HTML, including the 390 px check
At least three svg[data-sketch] pictures are used
Visible body text is at most 450 words
The page ends with a question for the students, with the answer hidden or separate
The mechanism is explained as numbered steps
Any statistic or figure on the page is either common textbook knowledge or cited

evals.name: wau-chart-for-team-update
evals.prompt: here's our weekly active users for the last 8 weeks: 1210, 1340, 1295, 1460, 1520, 1610, 1580, 1745. we shipped the new onboarding in week 4. can you make one sketchy chart i can paste into our team update as an image
evals.expected_output: A sketchy chart page with a line chart of the 8 values, an in-place annotation at week 4, the exact values in the hidden data table, and a PNG of the chart.

assertions.text: An HTML file with a figure.sk-chart exists
A PNG image of the chart exists
The hidden data table contains exactly the eight values 1210, 1340, 1295, 1460, 1520, 1610, 1580, 1745 in order
Week 4 is annotated in place on the chart (a note or marker at the fourth point), not only in a legend or caption
The chart title states what the data shows, not just 'Weekly active users'
lint.mjs reports 0 errors on the chart HTML
